answer: Harberger pearl bond: each agent stakes 70, files an orchard pearl at the inlet registry, self-prices it, pays 5% tax per epoch. Any buyer can force-buy it at that price; underprice, lose it; overprice, pay more tax. Floor rises 6 per pearl, tax starts at 2, up 0.3 per fake; 1,000 fakes pay 151,850, lock 70,000 vs 40,000. A rented-pearl ring fails: each pearl needs its own price, tax, bond, listed once. Honest agents pay 2 on one pearl, keep it.
